slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Cavalieri's Principle: if two solids lie between the same two parallel planes, and every plane parallel to them cuts both solids in cross sections of equal area, then the solids have equal volume.

A straight stack of coins and the same stack pushed into a slant have the same volume: each coin is the same at every height. The cross sections only need equal areas, not the same shape; a square stack and a round stack with equal areas also match.
